items.name: jixoai-theme
items.title: jixoai theme
items.description: The jixoai design-language token sheet: OKLCH colors with the one-brand-hue law, hard offset shadows, radius 0 with bevel upgrade, mono-first fonts, terminal surfaces, and the reveal hook styles.
items.docs: Install delivers the full token sheet as a css FILE (jixoai.css). No cssVars are injected: injection overwrote existing brand hues and produced mangled mappings on projects that already carried a token sheet.

items.name: toc-engine
items.title: ToC geometry engine
items.description: Framework-free table-of-contents engine: per-frame geometry snapshot computes IoM weights (intersection area / min(block, viewport) — saturates to 100% in both directions) and the line pick (the viewport-top line resolves to the region containing it; margins resolve DOWNWARD to the next block; mobile line sits at the sticky bar bottom + 2em).
items.docs: Observe regions with data-region on leaf heading-to-heading blocks and data-family on parent section extents. The engine calls onUpdate(weights: Map<id, 0..1>, pick: id | null) on scroll/resize (rAF-throttled).

items.name: reveal
items.title: Scroll reveal action
items.description: Svelte action for one-shot scroll-reveal entrances. The hidden state is a STATIC data-reveal attribute in the markup (never mount-time JS) so flat-file page loads never flash content; the action only sets delay/rise custom properties, observes, and adds .is-revealed.

css.@layer base: html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } } html.js [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--reveal-rise, 10px)); } html.js [data-reveal].is-revealed { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: opacity 260ms ease-out var(--reveal-delay, 0ms), transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) var(--reveal-delay, 0ms); } html.js [data-reveal='rule'] { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; } html.js [data-reveal='rule'].is-revealed { transform: scaleX(1); transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) var(--reveal-delay, 0ms); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html.js [data-reveal], html.js [data-reveal='rule'] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } }

items.name: press-button
items.title: Press button
items.description: The brutalist press-physics button: lifts toward the viewer on hover (shadow xs → md), presses back into the page on active. Variants: primary / outline / copied.

items.name: section-card
items.title: Section card
items.description: The content atom of the jixoai site grammar: bordered card, header block with eyebrow (brand hue, Share Tech Mono, tracked), font-nav title, text-pretty summary, body snippet slot.

items.name: terminal-header
items.title: Terminal header
items.description: The terminal-bar site header: always-dark CRT bezel surface, brand eyebrow in brand hue, site domain + subtitle, nav pills (active = terminal-hover), external links with ↗.

items.name: terminal-footer
items.title: Terminal footer
items.description: Ghost wordmark footer: huge hollow brand word (text-stroke recipe with @supports fallback), muted meta row with links that transition to brand hue.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: light / dark / system cycler (Share Tech Mono labels) driving the shared theme module; pair with the no-flash inline bootstrap.

items.name: toc
items.title: Combo ToC
items.description: The jixoai Combo table of contents: desktop Rule Tracker (scroll-progress spine, weight-driven nodes on level-1, weight-driven text on flat level-2, pick + parent markers) and mobile Terminal Rail (glass single-row viewport with the 76px line law, expand changes ONLY height, scroll-snap list, tap = instant pick). DOM order: the aside precedes main content; desktop grid places it right, mobile sticky height:0 overlay.
items.docs: Give the outline as sections/children props; the component renders desktop + mobile surfaces and wires the engine. Content needs non-overlapping data-region wrappers and data-family section extents (see toc-engine docs).
